summary: Of Lavenham, Suffolk, buried there in 1621; John's 12th-great-grandfather.
bio: William Payne, or Paine, lived at Lavenham in Suffolk, where he was buried on 9 June 1621. Earlier generations of the Payne family at Boxted, Suffolk, including a William born about 1502 and a Thomas who died in 1544, have been proposed as his forebears, but that descent is speculative.
